strongest_objection: Circularity: redistributing payments among fixed births can identify a physical token but assumes the recipient already exists. The original source spare can change both the eligible group and the size of the grant.
design_response: Identify the recipient from the older parent groups before computing H’s grant. Independently reconstruct funding, then enumerate H allocations on the same value-compatible prefix while both releases and downstream opportunities remain. Withholding H altogether with that roster is a separate question. A whole-cut stall or a supplied source edit does not isolate it.
